data.notes: January 2026 in Lagos was anchored by post-Detty December spillover parties and AFRIMA’s citywide awards-week programming.

events.title: AfroXela DJ Marathon: 96 Hours Non-Stop Music Beach Party
events.venueName: Nautica Beach Resort / Elegushi Beach area
events.summary: A 96-hour beach DJ marathon billed with 100+ DJs including DJ Consequence, DJ Neptune, DJ Bella and DJ Jimmy Jatt, running through New Year’s week in Lekki.

events.title: Mainland BlockParty: Mission 26K
events.summary: Mainland BlockParty opened the year with its Mission 26K Lagos edition at Police College, Ikeja, positioned as a large-scale youth-culture party.

events.title: Alibaba January 1st Concert 2026
events.summary: Alibaba’s long-running New Year variety concert returned to Eko Convention Center with comedy, music and entertainment programming.

events.title: K1 De Ultimate New Year Fest
events.summary: The 5th-anniversary New Year concert by Fuji icon K1 De Ultimate was listed for Queens Park Event Centre in Lagos.

events.title: Soul ’N’ Sooya with DOTTi The Deity
events.venueName: J Randle Centre for Yorùbá Culture & History
events.summary: DOTTi The Deity hosted a concert-meets-party concept blending soul, rave energy and Lagos nightlife at J Randle Centre.

events.title: Dwin, The Stoic — Master of Ballads Tour: Lagos
events.summary: Dwin, The Stoic brought the Master of Ballads Tour to Lagos for a full concert at MUSON Centre’s Shell Hall.

events.title: Apala Disco Night
events.summary: Apala Disco Night was listed with DJ Tunez, Musiliu Haruna Ishola, Terry Apala, Broda Shaggi and special guests for an Apala-meets-Afrobeats live show.

events.title: DayBreeze: Y2K Nolly Party
events.summary: DayBreeze closed its Detty December run with a Y2K Nollywood-themed rooftop party at The Wings Tower.

events.title: ÀRÍYÁ Village — A Yorùbá Imaginarium
events.venueName: J Randle Centre for Yorùbá Culture & History
events.summary: ÀRÍYÁ Village ran into early January with live music, dance shows, drumming, DJ sets, fashion, film and food programming centered on Yorùbá culture.

events.title: 9th All Africa Music Awards (AFRIMA)
events.summary: AFRIMA’s 9th edition took place in Lagos across five days of awards-week programming in partnership with the African Union Commission and Lagos State.

events.title: AFRIMA Music Village
events.summary: AFRIMA Music Village was announced as an open-air festival at Ikeja City Mall featuring more than 25 A-list artists and DJs from across Africa.
